blocks.removed: `uv run gz check` is the per-change gate: every quality check except `Behave` and `Preflight`, which `uv run gz check --full` adds and CI runs. `uv run gz check --fast` is an inner-loop check and never satisfies the gate. Run `git add -A` before `gz check`: a pass is recorded as verified only for a fully staged tree, otherwise the pre-push gate reruns it.
